$comment: Source of truth for the shared identity of Yurii Serhiichuk's web properties. identity/build.mjs writes identity/dist/ from this file. Do not edit the files in dist/ by hand. See identity/README.md.

surface-2.use: Code block, table head, inset area

border-strong.use: Edge of an input or a control (3:1)

accent.use: Link and focus ring of the person sites. A project site uses its own brand accent.

accent-solid.use: Fill of a primary button and of the YS mark

focus.$comment: Since 1.1.0. The focus ring is: outline var(--ys-focus-width) solid var(--ys-focus-color, var(--ys-<fallback>)). No bundle sets --ys-focus-color. A site sets it to its own accent. Each colour in 'colors' must meet 3:1 against each background in 'against'.

print.$comment: Since 1.1.0. In print, each bundle uses the light colours with these replacements, also when the page pinned dark.

font.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", Arial, sans-serif
font.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Liberation Mono", monospace
